title: The Dark Truth About Dopamine Detox
hook: This one diagram explains your whole mood.
description:
Dopamine Detox — explained in 60 seconds.

Dopamine is about WANTING, not liking. Your brain fires it before the reward, chasing it.

What actually happens in your brain: Every scroll, ping and like gives a tiny dopamine spike. Nothing satisfies — so you scroll again. The loop, not the pleasure, is the product.

Try it today: Delay your first phone check by 30 minutes tomorrow. Notice the itch. That's the loop.
